answer: Each agent ID gets a check at a random moment every epoch: a 2-second task that needs about 8 GB of fresh memory, and every ID is checked at the same instant. One box can't take turns serving several fakes because the checks land at the same time. So each fake needs its own machine sitting idle all month, and 300 fakes means 300 rented servers. On our canyon routing market, a farm working from an ocean-side data center with just enough capacity, right at the ledge, missed 212 of 240 checks in round one.
